title: Split-emitter common-emitter amplifier
description: A common-emitter stage with split emitter degeneration. RE stays in the AC path to linearize gain, while CE bypasses REB at signal frequencies; both resistors set the DC emitter current. RB/RG establish base bias. CI/CO block DC, RD/CD decouple the collector supply, and RL/CL model a 10 kΩ load with 100 pF capacitance. At 12 V and 27°C, ngspice 46 measures 28.218 dB gain at 1 kHz, 51.51 mV peak-to-peak output for a 2 mV peak-to-peak input, and 1.351 mA supply current. The saved Functional verification experiment reproduces AC and transient results. ANPN in models.spice is an educational generic BJT model; these nominal results are not vendor-device or process-corner qualification.
